scientific_integrity.finding: Exact labelled edge-open-packing polynomial of K_m Cartesian K_n for m,n at least two, equivalent two-sort exponential generating function, sharp parity-based packing number, and exact maximum-packing multiplicity.
limitations: Labelled two-dimensional rook graphs; empty packing included by enumeration convention.
Prior work established general induced-star description and Cartesian-product bounds; neither is claimed as new.
No claim concerning injective edge-coloring counts or larger Hamming graph products.
Priority assessment is provisional; no independent mathematical audit.
The 2022 original article is verified by year only; the date is the first exactly dated publicly accessible arXiv lead source (2024-03-01), not the original definition date.
scientific_integrity.proof_type: Explicit reversible decomposition into three permitted component types with disjoint row/column supports; labelled block counting; support inequalities and extremal equality-case classification.
scientific_integrity.verification: Independent literal enumeration of selected edge subsets of 15 rook graphs with 852443 compatible sets; exact extremal arithmetic on 261 further parameter profiles; these finite checks corroborate but do not prove the infinite statements.

title: Edge-open-packing polynomials and the parity obstruction for rook graphs
